def re_arrange(arr):
    # Separate positive and negative numbers
    pos = [x for x in arr if x > 0]
    neg = [x for x in arr if x <= 0]

    # Alternate between positive and negative numbers
    result = []
    i, j = 0, 0
    while i < len(pos) and j < len(neg):
        result.append(neg[j])
        result.append(pos[i])
        i += 1
        j += 1

    # Add remaining positive or negative numbers
    result.extend(pos[i:])
    result.extend(neg[j:])

    return result
